consequence.statement: CiliumLoadBalancerIPPool resources using spec.cidrs must be migrated to spec.blocks before upgrading to v1.16; the cidrs field will be removed.
consequence.remediation: Update all CiliumLoadBalancerIPPool resources to use spec.blocks instead of spec.cidrs before upgrading to Cilium v1.16.

original.statement: The CiliumLoadBalancerIPPool.spec.cidrs field is removed in v1.16; environments must migrate to spec.blocks before upgrading.

decision.reason: [ev-a6c56e62cf47] says the `cidrs` field "will be removed in v1.16" and tells operators to "update your IP pool configurations to use `blocks` instead of `cidrs` before upgrading". That is an explicit mandatory step before the upgrade, so migration-required is the right kind. The deterministic schema checks confirm spec.cidrs is in the v2alpha1 schema at the source release and gone at the target [ev-0b16ef08fe62, ev-f958ebb9b848]. The proposed statement and remediation match the evidence wording without claiming a failure mode the text doesn't state.
